During operation, Open-World 3D Scene Graph RAG applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to open-vocabulary objects; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

Dynamic graph construction updates semantic and spatial relationships as observations evolve. For Open-World 3D Scene Graph RAG, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of open-vocabulary objects.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (open-vocabulary objects) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
